key_insight: Topology optimization and generative design can unlock lightweight, high-performance additive-manufactured parts, but the best computational design must still be filtered through real manufacturing constraints.
engineering_relevance: For industrial AM, the practical value of TO/GD depends on build orientation, supports, feature size, residual stress, thermal distortion, surface finish, post-processing, and cost, not just structural optimality.
method: Compares topology optimization, generative design, and additive manufacturing constraints
Synthesizes algorithms, tools, industrial applications, and research gaps
evidence_signal: The paper is a literature-based systematic synthesis rather than a new experimental dataset, and its conclusions are drawn from reported applications and methodological review.
watch_item: Reported benefits are application-specific, so solutions that look optimal in simulation may fail in manufacturability, reliability, or economics without coupled design-process validation.
paper_title: Topology Optimization and Generative Design in Additive Manufacturing: A Systematic Review of Algorithms, Tools and Industrial Applications
